trigger.description: SRR6.46.3 auto-enrollment ran against a workspace whose IntendedLanePolicy or operator-supplied include/exclude overrides disqualify every discovered peer (all candidates land in an excluded set or the policy decision returns Block for the discovered universe). Auto-enrollment refuses to silently widen the policy; the operator sees the policy block surfaced rather than the absence misread as `_no_eligible_peers`.
setup_commands: ee mesh auto-enroll --workspace . --exclude '*' --json   # blanket exclude blocks every candidate
